title: Split test_dxf_security_patch.py by concern and delete its never-collected twin
intent: Test-only. Clears the two findings PR #349 recorded as deferred: the live module sat ~2 lines under the 500-line debt ceiling while covering six unrelated concerns, and a never-collected duplicate of it lived under app/tests/. Splits the module into four and deletes the duplicate. All 24 tests are preserved. No production code changes.

diff_articulation.what_changed: services/api/tests/test_dxf_security_patch.py (498 lines, six concerns) is split into test_dxf_upload_guard.py (133), test_spatial_hash.py (237), test_graph_algorithms_dfs.py (57) and test_dxf_operation_timeouts.py (93), and removed. services/api/app/tests/test_dxf_security_patch.py, a never-collected self-skipping duplicate, is deleted.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: PR #349 recorded both of these as deferred low findings rather than fixing them, to keep that PR a single increment. This is the follow-up increment they were deferred into. It carries its own manifest rather than amending #349's, which is already merged and describes what actually landed there.

commands_run: DEFERRED ITEM 1 - dead twin. Re-verified before deleting rather than trusting the note from #349, and that note was imprecise: it said the file 'would error if it ran'. It does not. The module carries `pytestmark = pytest.mark.skip(reason="Test API mismatch: tests do not match actual implementation")`, so all 22 of its tests skip and never reach the bad SpatialHash(tolerance=...) call. The TypeError is real but unreachable, and the skip mark shows the divergence was already known.

Positive-trace evidence for deletion, three independent strands: (1) `pytest --collect-only` over the default paths yields 0 tests from app/tests/, because testpaths is 'tests' in pytest.ini and ["tests"] in pyproject.toml; (2) the module disables itself with the skip mark above; (3) a live twin covers the same subject under services/api/tests/. Explicitly targeting the file collects 22 tests and all 22 skip.

No live reference anywhere: the only hits for the path are historical logs under reports/archaeology/, which record the original 'test: skip test_dxf_security_patch.py (API mismatch with actual implementation)' commit.

DEFERRED ITEM 2 - module split. Largest resulting file is 237 lines against the 500-line ceiling, so headroom goes from ~2 lines to ~263 and the next author is not forced into a trim-or-baseline decision.

The split was performed programmatically by slicing class boundaries, not by hand, so no test could be silently dropped in transcription. Test count verified identical: 24 before, 24 after. One missing import (validate_file_size, UploadFile, io) in the timeouts module was caught immediately by the suite and fixed.
py -3.11 -m pytest tests/test_dxf_upload_guard.py tests/test_spatial_hash.py tests/test_graph_algorithms_dfs.py tests/test_dxf_operation_timeouts.py -q --no-cov -> 24 passed

py -3.11 -m pytest tests/ --collect-only -q --no-cov -> 8869 tests collected; the single collection error is tests/test_pg_pool.py 'No module named aiosqlite', pre-existing local environment drift that CI does not have. No new collection error introduced.
py -3.11 -m app.ci.check_file_sizes --baseline app/ci/file_sizes_baseline.json -> 'OK: No files exceed 500 lines'
app/cam/spatial_hash.py and every other production module are untouched.

findings.summary: services/api/app/tests/ is a wholly uncollected parallel test tree; this change removes one file from it, not the tree.
findings.detail: testpaths excludes app/tests/ in both pytest.ini and pyproject.toml, so none of its 22 entries run -- including whole subdirectories (rmos, calculators, instrument_geometry, integration, ai_graphics). Only the duplicate in this PR's scope was assessed and deleted; the rest is untouched and unassessed here.
findings.disposition: DEFERRED - auditing an entire dead test tree is its own change and needs its own evidence per file. Recorded so the scope of this deletion is not mistaken for a tree-wide cleanup.

architecture_scan.acknowledgement_notes: Test-only reorganisation and one dead-file deletion. No production code, no API, no schema, no dependency change. All 24 live tests preserved and passing.

no_backend_no_schema: No backend API, route, schema, persistence, workflow, or build change.
